patthana15.40:1.1: cetasikaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na cetasiko na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. tīṇi,
patthana15.40:2.1: cetasikaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na cetasiko na akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. tīṇi,
patthana15.40:3.1: acetasikaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na acetasiko na abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. tīṇi.
